The posterior probability that Sable is Honest given the history of 4 corroborated and 2 contradicted reports is  

\[
P(\text{Honest}\mid\text{data})=\frac{P(\text{data}\mid\text{Honest})\,P(\text{Honest})}{P(\text{data}\mid\text{Honest})\,P(\text{Honest})+P(\text{data}\mid\text{Dishonest})\,P(\text{Dishonest})}.
\]

For an Honest informant each report is corroborated with probability \(0.8\); for a Dishonest informant it is corroborated with probability \(0.3\).

With 6 independent reports:

* Under **Honest**: \(\displaystyle P(\text{4 C, 2 D}) = \binom{6}{4}(0.8)^4(0.2)^2 = 15\cdot0.4096\cdot0.04 = 0.24576.\)

* Under **Dishonest**: \(\displaystyle P(\text{4 C, 2 D}) = \binom{6}{4}(0.3)^4(0.7)^2 = 15\cdot0.0081\cdot0.49 = 0.059535.\)

Using the prior \(P(\text{Honest})=0.4\) and \(P(\text{Dishonest})=0.6\),

\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{Numerator} &= 0.24576 \times 0.4 = 0.098304,\\[2mm]
\text{Denominator} &= 0.24576 \times 0.4 + 0.059535 \times 0.6 
= 0.098304 + 0.035721 = 0.134025.
\end{aligned}
\]

Hence

\[
P(\text{Honest}\mid\text{data}) = \frac{0.098304}{0.134025}
= \frac{98304}{134025} \approx 0.733475\;.
\]

Rounded to six decimal places:

\[
\boxed{0.733475}
\]

The artisan’s net payoff from effort \(e\) and bonus \(\Delta\) is  

\[
U(e)=\text{base wage }b+\Delta\cdot p_{\text{good}}(e)-c(e),
\]

where the cost of high effort is \(c_H=10\), low effort \(c_L=2\).  
For high effort \(H\): \(p_{\text{good}}=0.8\); for low effort \(L\): \(p_{\text{good}}=0.5\).

Thus  

\[
U_H=b+0.8\Delta-10,\qquad 
U_L=b+0.5\Delta-2.
\]

The workshop chooses the base wage so that the participation constraint binds at a reservation utility of 0.  
To make low effort just binding we set \(U_L=0\):

\[
b+0.5\Delta-2=0\;\Longrightarrow\; b=2-0.5\Delta .
\]

Substituting this \(b\) into \(U_H\),

\[
U_H=(2-0.5\Delta)+0.8\Delta-10
      =0.3\Delta-8.
\]

For high effort to be preferred (incentive‑compatible) we need \(U_H\ge 0\).  
The smallest \(\Delta\) that makes this true is when \(U_H=0\):

\[
0.3\Delta-8=0\;\Longrightarrow\; \Delta=\frac{8}{0.3}=\frac{80}{3}=26.\overline{6}.
\]

Hence the minimal good‑outcome bonus that yields a (weak) incentive to choose high effort is  

\[
\boxed{26.666667}
\] 

(rounded to six decimal places).
